{{Quote|I'll have the pilot sent to a safe house where you will pick him up.|[[Wolff Kalos]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
A '''Rebel Safe House''' located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|My guards are reporting that the attack was a diversion and that the pilot is gone! While we were busy, another group smuggled him out! This is a disaster!|A Rebel head guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and Rebel agents on Rori were involved in the hunt for [[Cal Handro]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had vanished after crash-landing on Rori while transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] was leading the investigation for the Empire. In the meantime, Rebel Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] had a similar mission for the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Within Your Grasp"</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
A group of spacers recruited by Rebel Officer [[Veega Madish]] finally found Cal Handro at an [[Martano estate|estate]] owned by the wealthy gambler [[Tierce Martano]]. At this point, Handro was now considered as a traitor by the Alliance for having smuggled slaves. After the adventurers rescued Martano who was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] henchmen, the gambler accepted to give the location of Handro to to the spacers who contacted Wolff Kalos. The latter immediately sent agents to pick Cal Handro and transferred him to the safe house. However, the Empire also got the information and Officer M'Kae promptly dispatched a group of mercenary to attack the building. Although the spacers arrived rapidly to help the Rebel forces, the pilot used the diversion to escape with a group of Imperial agents.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}

Cal Handro was eventually killed in his [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|starship]] during a space battle between Imperial and Rebel forces in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" /><ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Empire!"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Safe House was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Safe House was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]", on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either Rebel Officer Wolff Kalos or Imperial Officer M'Kae. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> If the player chose the Empire, he/she would have to fight in an [[Imperial Safe House]] instead.<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
